papers.title: DualScope: Capturing Critical Spatial and Temporal Cues for Distracted Driving Activity Recognition
papers.authors: Zhijie Qiu; Shuaibo Li; Laixin Zhang; Xuming Hu; Wei Ma
papers.dataset: Eight checkpoint variants are listed; exact paper dataset matrix requires full reproduction
papers.evaluation_protocol: Cross-dataset distracted-driving classification; exact split details not reproduced locally
papers.metrics_and_definition: Classification metrics reported by paper; not Roadwatch event F1
papers.license: MIT on model card; repository license not independently reverified
papers.transferable_method: Critical-region pooling, dynamic differences, motion encoder, fine-to-coarse temporal pyramid
papers.estimated_cost: Full reproduction needs GPU; lightweight causal feature analogue fits CPU
papers.roadwatch_difference: Paper classification protocol differs from Roadwatch frozen event matching
papers.limitations: No weights downloaded and no claimed reproduction under current rights/compute gates

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Can Identify Distracted Driver Behavior from Naturalistic Videos
papers.authors: Md Zahid Hasan; Jaijing Chen; Jiyang Wang; Mohammed Shaiqur Rahman; Ameya Joshi
papers.year_venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems 2024
papers.dataset: DMD, StateFarm, SynDD1, SAM-DD according to official repository
papers.evaluation_protocol: Repository provides driver-profile split files; local protocol not reproduced
papers.metrics_and_definition: Frame/clip classification metrics; not Roadwatch event metrics
papers.checkpoint: Repository model_ckpt lineage not locally verified
papers.transferable_method: Frozen CLIP embeddings, zero-shot prompts, task adapter
papers.estimated_cost: ViT-L/14 memory and download exceed this low-RAM CPU audit budget
papers.roadwatch_difference: Frame/clip labels and semantic prompts do not prove event recovery
papers.limitations: D4 blocked by checkpoint, memory, and rights gates

papers.title: Enhancing Driver Monitoring Systems Based on Novel Multi-Task Fusion Algorithm
papers.authors: Romas Vijeikis; Ibidapo Dare Dada; Adebayo A. Abayomi-Alli; Vidas Raudonis
papers.dataset: DMD plus AUC_V2 and SAMDD robustness evaluation
papers.evaluation_protocol: DMD 70/20/10 and five-fold evaluation described by article
papers.metrics_and_definition: Task classification/attentiveness metrics; not frozen Roadwatch Event F1
papers.license: Open-access article; model/code license not verified
papers.transferable_method: BODY/FACE/HANDS reliability masks and BiLSTM task fusion
papers.estimated_cost: Moderate GPU training; lightweight reliability logic fits CPU
papers.roadwatch_difference: Roadwatch has missing views and only three repeated development subjects
papers.limitations: Missing camera evidence must remain UNKNOWN

papers.title: ActionFormer: Localizing Moments of Actions with Transformers
papers.authors: Chenlin Zhang; Jianxin Wu; Yin Li
papers.dataset: Temporal action-localization benchmarks including THUMOS14 and ActivityNet
papers.metrics_and_definition: Temporal mAP over IoU thresholds; distinct from Roadwatch matcher
papers.transferable_method: Multi-scale causal candidates and separate boundary evidence
papers.estimated_cost: Repository reports about 4.5 GB training VRAM and over 10 GB inference VRAM for THUMOS setup
papers.roadwatch_difference: Roadwatch lacks an approved large event-training set
papers.limitations: Full model blocked; only design ideas are adopted

papers.title: Domain Generalization with MixStyle
papers.authors: Kaiyang Zhou; Yongxin Yang; Yu Qiao; Tao Xiang
papers.transferable_method: Mix feature statistics to reduce cabin/style dependence
papers.estimated_cost: Low incremental training cost, but still requires approved train data
papers.roadwatch_difference: Only three repeatedly studied subjects are currently available
papers.limitations: V11 uses deterministic normalization analogue, not a MixStyle reproduction

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Neural Networks for Group Shifts
papers.authors: Shiori Sagawa; Pang Wei Koh; Tatsunori Hashimoto; Percy Liang
papers.evaluation_protocol: Worst-group validation with regularization and early stopping
papers.estimated_cost: Low-to-moderate, but statistically weak with three subjects
papers.roadwatch_difference: Roadwatch groups are repeatedly reused and too few for a strong Group DRO claim
papers.limitations: Group DRO not run; worst-subject gating is used instead

papers.title: Seatbelt Detection Algorithm Improved with Lightweight Approach and Attention Mechanism
papers.authors: Liankui Qiu; Jiankun Rao; Xiangzhe Zhao
papers.metrics_and_definition: Paper reports 98.25% accuracy; not Roadwatch three-state Macro-F1
papers.license: Open-access article; reusable data/model license not verified
papers.transferable_method: Torso ROI, Triplet Attention, channel pruning
papers.estimated_cost: Moderate training; blocked until labels and rights are approved
papers.limitations: Binary visibility assumptions cannot relabel invisible belts as UNFASTENED

papers.title: Real-time Detection of Seat Belt Usage in Overhead Traffic Surveillance Using YOLOv7
papers.authors: Catur Edi Widodo; Kusworo Adi; Priyono Priyono; Aji Setiawan
papers.dataset: Day/night overhead road images with car, windshield, passenger, and seatbelt classes
papers.metrics_and_definition: Paper reports mAP50 97.46%, F1 95.37%, seatbelt AP 93.40%
papers.license: CC BY 4.0 article; dataset/model license not verified
papers.estimated_cost: YOLOv7 GPU training; not justified locally
papers.roadwatch_difference: Overhead roadside imagery differs from in-cabin DMD
papers.limitations: Paper values cannot be transferred across domain or metric
